verdict.rationale: The open-source Orama library is entirely programmatic: schema creation, insert/insertMultiple, facets, vector/hybrid search and AnswerSession are all code APIs. Orama Cloud offers official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs for search, plus a per-project MCP server for agent access to project data. However, nothing documents that Cloud dashboard operations (creating projects, data sources and collections, choosing embedding models) are available through the API, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every path. Missing for 10: documented API/SDK coverage of Cloud management and dashboard actions, a published OpenAPI spec, and any explicit API–UI parity statement or independent corroboration.
